body.x: The pre-shift setup steps required of all staff before clocking in and starting work.
Every staff member, before every shift. This is the department's operational pre-shift checklist. The full attendance policy is owned by HR (see the HR SOP Library, Chapter 7).

x: VPN must stay on for the entire shift. Report disconnections to the ATL or TL immediately.
Clock in at least 5 minutes early, to avoid a late record from system lag.
Always browse in Google Chrome Incognito mode, for security. The full rule and its enforcement live in the Incognito Browsing SOP (38).

head: Action

rows: Select LPK01 or TH01; verify your location is correct (not the wrong country); check IP at whatismyipaddress.com
Clock in on the Insightful (Workpuls) app
At least 5 minutes early, to avoid a late record from system lag
Open Google Chrome in Incognito mode
Always browse in private mode for security

x: Failure to clock in during working hours, or clock out after, on Insightful triggers progressive warnings (see Work Policy).
Late arrivals are subject to monetary deductions (see Work Policy, Annex A).
A wrong VPN location or a dropped VPN mid-shift must be reported to the ATL/TL at once.
The full attendance policy sits with HR (HR SOP Library, Chapter 7); this SOP is the pre-shift checklist only.
Document code HR02 (changed from HR01 to avoid a clash with New Agent Onboarding, HR01). Confirmed by the ATL on 24 Sep 2026.
